summary: Each environment now shows its own name, so several open PIM Managers are easy to tell apart.

new.title: Name each environment
new.text: A SuperAdmin sets the name under Settings > Environment name. It shows at the top of every page and in the browser tab.

new.title: Restore configuration after a rebuild
new.text: A restored backup can be copied into a running environment. It shows a plan first, pauses the engine and never overwrites existing definitions.

fixes.title: No false Azure blocked warning
fixes.text: Without Azure resource delegations, missing Azure rights no longer show as blocked.
